constant_log_two.qualification: The API receives rounded binary64 log(2), so equality is qualified numerically rather than asserted as exact.

limits: Authored mechanics only. Finite rounded recurrences have numerical error and do not by themselves establish a regret or empirical outcome guarantee. Priors in ideal statements sum exactly one.
